title: Orthonormal frames with the same values on all n-covectors span the same plane
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let v = (v_1, …, v_n) and v' = (v'_1, …, v'_n) be orthonormal families in ℝ^P (Orthonormal ℝ v, Orthonormal ℝ v'). Assume β(v_1, …, v_n) = β(v'_1, …, v'_n) for every n-covector β on ℝ^P, i.e. every continuous alternating n-linear form β : (ℝ^P)^n → ℝ (β ∈ Covector (Euclid P) n). Then span{v_1, …, v_n} = span{v'_1, …, v'_n}, i.e. Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) = Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v').
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (v v' : Fin n → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ v → Orthonormal ℝ v' → (∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, β v = β v') → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) = Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v')
